## What's changed

- Adds Library Optimization, an optional server-managed workflow for reducing local movie and series storage with HEVC or AV1 while keeping large working files beside the source media instead of under `/config`.
- Detects usable software and hardware encoders, writable libraries, FFmpeg audio support, and available disk space before work begins, with a clear capability summary in Configuration.
- Adds configurable quality, best-English audio selection, commentary and descriptive-track filtering, audio format, subtitle cleanup, HDR preservation, and Dolby Vision protection.
- Skips HEVC and AV1 media that is already efficient by default, with an explicit opt-in for HEVC-to-AV1 conversion or track cleanup on efficient files.
- Verifies duration, video, audio, output size, and minimum savings before replacing a source; originals can be quarantined for a configurable safety window and are restored if installation fails.
- Adds manual analysis, progress and storage reporting, pause and cancel controls, automatic idle processing, playback-aware pausing, persistent history, and safe retries after failed automatic jobs.
- Updates the sample configuration and Docker documentation for writable local-library mounts and the new optimizer settings.

Library Optimization is off by default and is a server-only feature; existing players do not require an update.
